subject: Municipality of Limay

provenance.source_name: DTI Cities and Municipalities Competitiveness Index - Bataan municipalities
provenance.verification_note: Transcribed from the DTI CMCI export; unverified until a maintainer checks these scores against the CMCI rankings page.

howToRead: DTI Cities and Municipalities Competitiveness Index scores for Bataan municipalities. Limay is the subject of this portal; the other LGUs are shown for comparison and every record names its own geography. Higher scores are better. Pillar scores sum to the overall score.

omissions.2018: For 46 of 56 indicators the source reports 0.0000 in 2018 for all or all-but-one LGU. Those zeros denote 'not surveyed', not a score of zero, and are omitted. The remaining indicators carry real 2018 values and are published unchanged.
omissions.dash: Cells marked '-' in the source mean the indicator did not exist that year.
